os-2-13.alt: Two energy graphs side by side, each plotting energy against the progress of a reaction. Without an enzyme, the reactants must climb a tall hump before falling to the lower energy of the products. With an enzyme, the hump is much lower, while the starting and ending energies are the same as before.

os-2-27.alt: Four stages of an enzyme reaction: two substrate molecules approach the active site of an enzyme, bind in the active site, react while bound, and leave as a product while the enzyme returns to its starting shape.
